title: La settimana no di Sofia
summary: Week 6 review: immersion with Sofia's rough week — scooter trouble, illness, farmacia to medico

blocks.title: Ripasso: salute, sentimenti, consigli
blocks.body: This week: **il corpo** and *mi fa / mi fanno male*, the **farmacia-first** habit and *mal di…*, emergency phrases and **il 112**, **sentirsi** + feelings, and giving advice with **devi / dovresti** and **perché non…?**. Time to put it all to work — and to catch up with Sofia.
blocks.callout: Ripasso — everything from this week, in one story.

blocks.prompt: Sofia says her legs hurt after a long walk. Which is correct?
blocks.explain: *le gambe* is plural — fanno, not fa. A week-6 keeper.

blocks.prompt: Type: 'You should go to the pharmacy.'
blocks.explain: *Dovresti andare in farmacia* — the softer suggestion, perfect for a friend.

blocks.scene: At the bar, Sofia finally surfaces after a rough few days and tells Giulia, Marco, and 'You' what happened

lines.speaker: Giulia
lines.target: Sofia! Come stai? Sembri stanca morta.
lines.en: Sofia! How are you? You look dead tired.

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.target: Ho avuto una settimana orribile, ragazzi.
lines.en: I've had a horrible week, guys.

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.target: Lunedì lo scooter non è partito. Si è rotto, di nuovo!
lines.en: On Monday the scooter wouldn't start. It broke down, again!
lines.spotlight: si è rotto agrees with lo scooter, masculine — passato prossimo with essere.

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.target: E poi, mercoledì, mi sono sentita malissimo. Avevo la febbre e mal di gola.
lines.en: And then, on Wednesday, I felt awful. I had a fever and a sore throat.
lines.spotlight: mi sono sentita — feminine, because Sofia's talking about herself.

lines.speaker: You
lines.en: Did you go to the doctor?

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.target: Prima sono andata in farmacia — il farmacista mi ha detto di riposare e bere tanta acqua.
lines.en: First I went to the pharmacy — the pharmacist told me to rest and drink lots of water.

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.target: Ma la febbre non è passata, così sono andata dal medico giovedì.
lines.en: But the fever didn't go away, so I went to the doctor on Thursday.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.en: What a disaster! Are you better now?

lines.speaker: Sofia
lines.target: Sì, molto meglio, grazie. Ma che settimana!
lines.en: Yes, much better, thanks. What a week!

questions.q: Where did Sofia go first when she got sick?
How does Sofia feel by the end of the story?

blocks.prompt: Hai mai avuto una settimana come quella di Sofia? Racconta cosa è successo, cosa hai fatto, e come ti sei sentito/a.
